title: Python fragmentation targets IID while Rust and link draft require Extended EUI-64
description: Python Node sends authenticated SCHC fragments/controls to peer.iid and Link accepts Extended DST == identity.iid. Rust Link/SCHC/node consistently compares Extended DST to local_eui64 (IID with RFC4291 U/L bit flipped), and draft-lichen-link-01 defines Extended as an EUI-64. Cross-language peers therefore reject every exact-target fragment/control despite correct signatures. Make Extended wire destination canonical EUI-64 in spec/02 and Python Link/Node, derive it explicitly from key-derived IID, keep trust maps keyed by IID/full key as appropriate, and add Python↔Rust address/overhear/control vectors/tests.
